company.name: The Phoenix Desert Safari Dubai
company.address: DAMAC XL Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE

payment_rules.pay_on_arrival_policy: 100% Pay on Arrival. Zero advance deposit required. Guests pay Cash (AED, USD, EUR, GBP) or Credit/Debit Card to their driver/marshal upon pickup or at the camp. Free cancellation up to 12 hours prior.
payment_rules.advance_only_policy: Advance Payment Only. Official third-party venue gates (Emaar, Skydive Dubai) require advance payment to generate and issue digital mobile barcode admission passes.

Sandboarding on 300-foot high red dunes

5-star International BBQ Buffet Dinner with live grilling (Veg, Non-Veg, Jain)

faq_guidelines.pregnant_and_infants: Dune bashing is not recommended for pregnant women or infants under 3 years old due to steep dune angles and sudden crest drops. However, we provide a smooth, gentle direct transfer along flat desert roads straight to our Bedouin camp so they can relax in the VIP Majlis, watch the golden sunset, take gentle camel rides, and enjoy the 5-star BBQ dinner buffet and cultural shows in complete comfort.

pricing_calculations.six_pax_premium_safari: AED 850 total for private luxury Land Cruiser (seats up to 6 guests) with VIP table service, or AED 720 total (6 x AED 120) for standard shared evening safari.
pricing_calculations.six_pax_standard_safari: 6 adults x AED 120 = AED 720 total (or private car AED 750).
pricing_calculations.six_pax_burj_khalifa: 6 tickets x AED 175 = AED 1,050 total (Advance payment required).
